is_active.description: Indicates whether the DNS record is currently active

cached.description: List of Mailguns cached values for the DNS record

name.description: Name of the DNS record if applicable

priority.description: Priority value for MX DNS records

record_type.description: Type of DNS record such as MX TXT or CNAME

valid.description: Indicates whether the DNS record is valid

value.description: Expected value of the DNS record
